newsitem.title: FRANCE: France urges renewed Israel-Syria-Lebanon talks.
newsitem.headline: France urges renewed Israel-Syria-Lebanon talks.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac told visiting Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri on Tuesday he believed peace talks should resume between Israel, Syria and Lebanon.
"France hopes for a resumption of negotiations between Israel, Lebanon and Syria for a global accord according to the principle of land for peace," aides quoted him as telling his guest.
Talks under way last year between Syria and Israel's then-Labour government did not resume after rightist Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu took power in Israel last May.
Netanyahu opposes withdrawal from the Syrian Golan Heights, which Israel has occupied since 1967.
